trackers.product_line: Adjust's measurement SDK: attribution, analytics and fraud prevention for app marketers, run by a wholly owned AppLovin subsidiary
data_collected: the Android advertising ID, or the Android ID as a fallback; other identifiers on Amazon devices, and with plugins
sessions and app launches, by default
other in-app events, and purchase receipts for verification, if the developer sets them up
device metadata such as the operating system version
trackers.monetization_model: Adjust sells measurement, analytics and fraud prevention to app marketers and processes app users' data for them. AppLovin's 2025 annual report says data from Adjust's services isn't shared with AppLovin or used for its ad engine unless a customer directs it.

data_flows.purpose: Your Android advertising ID, or your Android ID when there isn't one, sent with everything the SDK sends, so the developer can tell which ad led to the install
data_flows.wording: According to Adjust's help centre and developer documentation (read 2026-10-08).
